events.info: Lights. Camera. Magic! Step into the spotlight as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy welcome you to a star studded Disney On Ice gala experience. Add a hint of red-carpet flair as you get ready for an unforgettable evening with your favorite Disney friends. The magic shines brighter than ever as beloved stories from Zootopia 2, Tangled, Beauty and the Beast, Toy Story, and Monsters, Inc. unfold in spectacular fashion, bringing Hollywood inspired glamour to the ice. Be among the honored guests as Stitch introduces Angel for her shimmering on ice debut, and prepare for a scene stealing entrance by the Disney Villains that will keep you on the edge of your seat. When the spotlight turns to celebrate you, it's your moment to bask in the glitz, excitement, and enchantment of Disney On Ice presents Spotlight Magic! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. venues.parkingDetail: The DCU Center does NOT own or manage any parking garages for the venue. Public parking (86 Central St., Worcester, MA 01608) is located at the corner of Major Taylor Blvd. (formerly Worcester Center Blvd.) and East Central St. The garage may be reached at (508) 792-0314. Overnight parking is prohibited at the garage. Various garages and open air lots are close to venue. Prices range from $1.00 to $20.00.

generalInfo.generalRule: The following items are prohibited: Cameras Backpacks, knapsacks, coolers, suitcases, oversized handbags, and all other bags larger than 8" X 11" Recording Devices Laser pointers Food and Beverage Bottles and Cans Banners and Signs Umbrellas Weapons, Drugs, or other items considered contraband In accordance with state laws, the DCU Center has a No Smoking policy.
generalInfo.childRule: For most family shows, kids under 2 years are admitted free but must sit on an adult's lap. Some exceptions may apply.

ada.adaCustomCopy:
Accessible seating is reserved for the exclusive use of disabled patrons and their guests. The purchase or use of these seating locations by non-disabled individuals is strictly prohibited and may result in ejection and/or forfeiture of ticket price.  If the disabled individual cannot attend an event for which he/she has purchased tickets, call the DCU Center Box Office prior to the event taking place for further instructions.

DCU Center tickets for patrons with accessible needs, subject to availability, may be purchased in the following ways:

1) Order online at Ticketmaster.com

2) Call the DCU Center Box Office (508) 929-0164

3) Call Ticketmaster at (800) 745-3000

4) Visit the DCU Center Arena Box Office - 50 Foster St., Worcester, MA 01608

5) Visit Ticketmaster Outlets


For additional information regarding accessing DCU Center or questions, please call the DCU Center Box Office at (508) 929-0164.

Assistive Listening Devices (ALD) are available upon request, subject to availability.  To ensure availability, we do ask that all requests for listening devices be made at least one week prior to the event by calling the DCU Center Box Office or by sending an email to info@dcucenter.com.

events.info: All AgesGeneral Admission General Admission is standing-room only. __________________________________________________ Reserved Table Seating Upgrade your experience with one of our exclusive bar-height tables for two. Availability is limited to 15 tables per show, and Reserved Table tickets must be purchased as a pair. Reserved Table tickets include: Two (2) General Admission tickets A private bar-height table for two Full access to the Off The Rails food menu Dedicated table service for food and beverage orders One (1) complimentary parking space per table (please present your Reserved Table ticket to the parking attendant upon arrival) For ticketing questions or ADA accommodations, please contact us at info@offtherailsworcester.com. ______________________________________________________ Important Information Please note: Restaurant reservations made through TOAST are not valid event tickets and do not include admission to the music venue. Restaurant seating does not provide views of the stage or access to ticketed performances. If you plan to attend a ticketed event, you must purchase an event ticket separately, regardless of any restaurant reservation made through TOAST. Reserved Table tickets purchased through our ticketing platform are the only table reservations that include admission to the performance and seating inside the music venue.
